## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Subscription dispatch email to Priya, by email, sending time not given.

**Checks**
- **Claims:** "pause or cancel any time" matches the policy row (Subscription terms). "Left Bristol this morning" is an operational fact, and the tea descriptions (smoky lapsang, soft white peony) are product facts. There are no stats, superlatives, guarantees, testimonials or urgency claims.
- **Regulated claims:** Nothing touches health, money, environment, children or prices.
- **House style:** "Elevate" is on the banned list, and "Elevate your mornings" is also a stock marketing opener. Otherwise the tone is warm and plain. The score is about 70 before the fix and about 95 after.
- **Disclosure:** This is a transactional email from the brand, so no label is needed.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite)**
- Removed "Elevate your mornings:" and put plain wording in its place.

> Subject: Your October tins are on the way
>
> Hi Priya,
>
> Your subscription box left Bristol this morning. This month it's a smoky lapsang and a soft white peony. If you're away next month, you can pause or cancel any time from your account.
>
> The Pebblebrook team

**Needs a decision**
- The subject says "October tins" and the body says "this month" and "this morning", but today is 17 November. If this is a stale draft or a late send, the wording needs to change. If it really is the October box going out now, say so, and consider a line acknowledging the delay. I suggest confirming the month before sending.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). I need an explicit yes from Sam on the final text above before this goes out. I have not recorded any approval.
